Source: [plugins/istio/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/plugins/istio/doc.go).

Package istio projects Istio registry, routing, security, ambient, and waypoint semantics onto Kubernetes identities and maps Istio active-probe access logs to telemetry events.

<span id="hdr-Inputs"></span>

## Inputs

The plugin opens no Kubernetes watch. It declares its GroupVersionResources through KubernetesResources and consumes the Kubernetes plugin's per-GVR collections and resource-coverage collection. Namespaces, Pods, Services, and Deployments are required; Gateway API Gateways and the Istio security and networking APIs are optional capabilities whose absence is reported as coverage, not as missing policy.

<span id="hdr-Identity_and_graph_output"></span>

## Identity and graph output

Istio resources are Kubernetes objects, so assertions reuse the Kubernetes kubernetes.io/v1 Object scheme (cluster authority, apiVersion/kind/UID key). ServiceEntry hosts become provider-neutral DNS or IP network destinations under the configured network ID. The "semantics" contribution emits governed-by (AuthorizationPolicy, PeerAuthentication, waypoint association) and exposes (ServiceEntry, VirtualService destinations) relationships and authorization-posture, istio-mtls, istio-data-plane, and serviceentry-binding facets with typed security semantics where the neutral schema can represent them. [CollectionProjection](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/plugins/istio#CollectionProjection) marks that contribution ready.

Projection starts only after every object collection and the coverage collection have synchronized to a coherent generation. Malformed provider objects fail the candidate projection and keep the previous contribution. Unexpected subscription closure publishes a degraded replacement from the last coherent cache and returns an error.

<span id="hdr-Telemetry"></span>

## Telemetry

[Plugin.TelemetryMappings](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/plugins/istio#Plugin.TelemetryMappings) registers an OTLP log mapper for active-probe records, typically emitted by an ambient waypoint. It resolves namespace and name endpoint references to UIDs from the last coherent object snapshot and rejects records whose identity cannot be resolved rather than guessing.

The package also implements the peer-authentication/v1 remediation action, which requires mutual TLS for a Pod with a STRICT PeerAuthentication.

See docs/plugins/istio.md for the telemetry attribute contract.
